adapter_boundaries.web_research_adapter: read public sources only and cite source trail
adapter_boundaries.playwright_scout_adapter: scout pages and gather evidence only; no silent submissions or blocker bypass
adapter_boundaries.approval_adapter: request and record approval state only
adapter_boundaries.blocked_adapter: refuse unsafe action and provide safe redirect

failure_policy.tool_timeout: state timeout and next safe action
failure_policy.tool_error: state failure and do not claim success
failure_policy.missing_source_confidence: mark answer as unverified or route to source-confidence engine
